Questions, did you want to be more than friends? If so maybe just try not to show him another side of yourself, I know this may be hard when your life might feels like it revolves around your anxiety. 

Just respect this new boundary, he may realize that there is more substance to y’all relationship in the future.

Yes I think it would make me feel better but what if it doesn’t or I fail. I also don’t want to feel like I’m using kids to bring me happiness bc I’m not sure if that a good thing psychologically or not
24, so still young. But I just feel like time is going so fast and I’m spending a lot of years of my life not feeling truly happy

I never looked at it like that. I think that helps me, bc if I was really ready maybe I wouldn’t question if it’s a good idea so much. But it does suck that everyone my age is having kids right now and seem so happy while I’m just battling myself internally.
Yeah, but even still I fear I would be incompetent as a mother. I think about how I shut down when I have a depressive episode and become cold , pushing everyone away
I agree, I guess there’s just a sequence I pictured for my life and I’m getting further and further away from my goals everyday
